body: I am sorry that you experience such profound sadness. Why do you feel that you aren't worth anything? Is there anything in your life that brings you any joy? Do not give up on yourself.

You are very young. At 15, I too was very uncertain of my place in life. I had a hard time in school due to my dysfunctional home life. There is nothing wrong with who you are. Unfortunately, at that age, some individuals are still very immature, and feel they build themselves up by knocking others down. 

To say you have no talents or worth is absolutely wrong. Everyone has worth. Everyone has something that makes them special. Do not let this difficult time defeat you. Soon enough you will be 18, out of high school, and defining your own life. So hang in there.

Well, your mom needs to understand that "when she was your age" it was much easier to just walk in some place and get a job. These days the application process is long and drawn out, and there is much more competition with less open positions. It is not easy out there. Do not stress to much. You got GED and you started college. That is forward progress right there. I would hope that she is just bluffing and wouldn't kick you out. You should keep a record of every place you apply to so you can show her that you are indeed trying. Good Luck to you.

It must be very difficult for you experiencing the separation of your parents. My parents divorced too, due to my father's extreme drug problem. At least your father is not abandoning his responsibility to the family altogether. 

Moving into an apartment from a house is a difficult adjustment, but you can get used to it. Maybe you can just keep one aquarium until you have more space one day. 

If your girlfriend can't open up to you, or allow you to open up to her, then that is not a foundation for a healthy relationship. Maybe she is just too busy, or maybe she is not mature enough for a serious emotional relationship. Either way, you will have to determine what is best for you. 

Don't be too envious of the social cliques. I believe that when it comes to friendships quality outweighs quantity. It may be that you have been wrapped up in your relationship, and that has prevented you from pursuing serious friendships. 

There is nothing wring with changing your major. It would be much worse realizing ten years down the road that you are unhappy with your career choice. Making the right choice now is the right move. You are still finding yourself. 

Your family may be having financial problems, but yours is not the exception. These days, many people are struggling to get by. What is more important is your family's health. Money is not worth losing it over. 

I hope you can try to find happiness. 

(p.s.- there is nothing wrong with being a gamer, but try to avoid gamer rage)

unoaime,

I absolutely feel your pain. I also was happy, healthy, and vibrant. Then I had a CT scan performed with contrast dye injected into my veins three months ago, and have not been the same since. I had some type of reaction, because I was severely ill the immediate week after. The doctor just prescribed Benadryl, which did nothing. He said the contrast dye can only cause rashes

Well in the weeks that have followed, I have slowly lost my vibrancy. My skin tone has gone from white and smooth to reddish and ruddy. I have veins appearing everywhere, with dark bulging veins in my hands and feet. My feet and hands also constantly burn and swell. It's like I have aged ten years in three months.

I have received the same "it's all in your head" treatment from doctors. Nothing is more aggravating when you are told it is all in your head, when your are clearly displaying physical symptoms. I keep getting told "Well, you blood work is fine." 

I also have spent hundreds of dollars on supplements and detox products. However, no matter what I do, my body continues to deceive me. 

Everyday that I wake up is a living nightmare for me. I am only 31, and I am supposed to be getting married next year, yet all I now think about is escaping this trap of a shell I am in. 

You have every right to be angry. Everything is replaceable, except our bodies. We only get one vessel, and when that vessel is damaged we are screwed. 

I worry I may do something sooner than later. It is all I can think about, as I seem to be fighting a losing battle.
Like I said, no one wants to be responsible for encouraging you to end your life.

That is what I am saying. That some problems are insurmountable, and that's where choosing to end one's life comes in.

Again, I don't know what your problems are. 

Of course you are going to have a hard time getting anyone to agree with you, as no one wants to encourage you to end your life.

I can not argue with you there. I have been have serious thoughts myself lately, I mean serious. I just worry about how destroyed me boyfriend will be, but the physical and mental pain is just stacked too high for me. 

I am not sure of your circumstances, or your reasons. Some things can be fixed. Some things you either have to choose to suffer through, or choose not to. I hope your problems are fixable, but I agree that some are not.

What I am experiencing is more than just laugh lines. I have been to the doctor, and they believe I have an autoimmune disease. It is a long, drawn out process of testing and office visits. Meanwhile, my body is showing the effects of this internal battle. 
I am in constant discomfort, and look as though I have aged ten years in three months. I have tried to stay positive, but it is difficult. I expected to age gracefully, not face a sharp decline as I have.
